notes.title: 🎉 Discover Our New Game: Mutants Ate My Carrots! 🥕✨
notes.notes:
Hey adventurers!

If you enjoyed Not Another Weekend, we have fantastic news for you. Our team is proud to announce our upcoming game: Mutants Ate My Carrots, developed by the talented Animatic Vision, the co-creators of Mike's amazing adventure!

🌟 What’s the story?
Step into a fairytale forest in decay, where a selfish king lion rules, mutants roam, and a black rabbit fights to reclaim his stolen carrots. Solve puzzles, unlock skills, and battle mutants in this unique blend of classic point-and-click gameplay and skill-based combat!

🎮 Why you'll love it:

- Classic adventure gameplay with a fresh combat twist.
- Hand-drawn visuals and whimsical puzzles.
- A wacky world filled with humor, action, and charm.

Take a look here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2654690/Mutants_Ate_My_Carrots/

We plan for Q2 2025 release, please try the demo and give it a review if you like it! 🐰

And ofcourse, if you could wishlist the game, it would help us tremendously!

Thank you for your support, and we can’t wait to hear your thoughts on this mutant-filled adventure! 🥕

notes.title: Steam Deck Compatibility
notes.notes:
Hey all! We'd like to inform you that, even if Valve hasn't checked the game's compatibility with the Steam Deck yet, we have tested it internally and we can verify that it works nicely on the Steam Deck!

Controls:

Right Trackpad / RIght Joystick: Control Cursor
Right Trackpad Click / R2 : Walk / Default Action
L2 : Walk / Secondary Action (Look)
R1 / A: Show hotspots
L1 : Hide hotspots

We plan to update the control scheme for a smoother experience in the future, but you can still enjoy the game on the Steam Deck, looking forward to your comments!

notes.title: Mike needs your help!
notes.notes:
Heyho friends!

It’s been more than a year after Not Another Weekend release and we are really happy with the feedback and the love we receive daily for the game! Thank you all so much for this – you are amazing! ❤️

‘So, what’s the problem?’ you might ask.

As you might know already, classic point and click adventures are nowadays only a tiny niche in the enormously large video game market, overlooked by many. So it’s really critical for game devs and publishers to improve their games’ visibility, and that’s why need your help! Currently the game has 36 reviews (97% score!) and it would be great to increase this!

Step 1: The 50 reviews mark, can we do it?!
Step 2: Sky is the limit!

If you have played Not Another Weekend and didn’t do it yet, please leave a review here on Steam – or wherever you bought the game. Because the more reviews we can collect, the more visible our game becomes. And that would really help us tremendously with our next projects! ❤️

Thank you!
Chris
Dionous Games

Vote link: https://adventuregamers.com/articles/view/aggie-awards-readers-choice-poll-2021
